Class NitriteTypeRegistry

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.mapping.NitriteTypeRegistry
@Internal public final class NitriteTypeRegistry extends Object
Central registry of per-type Nitrite serialization rules. Each concrete type is registered once with its PropertyStrategy, a write function (Java value → Nitrite storage format), and optional reverse functions for reading back from a stored Number or String.

Adding support for a new type requires only a single add(Class, PropertyStrategy, Function, Function, Function) call here; PropertyStrategy.classifyValueStrategy(Class, Class), ValueConverter.toFilterValueStatic(Object), ValueConverter.convertWithTemporalHandling(Object, Class), and the document mapper all delegate to this registry automatically.

Since:
5.2.0

    • write

      @Nullable public static @Nullable Object write(@Nullable @Nullable Object value)
      Converts value to its Nitrite storage format using the registered write function. Returns value unchanged if the type is not registered.

      Walks the superclass hierarchy to handle abstract registered types (e.g. Charset, ZoneId) whose concrete runtime class differs from the registered key.

      Parameters:
      value - the Java value to convert
      Returns:
      the Nitrite storage representation, or the original value if unregistered
